subject: general
question: With respect to Industry and Trade, MRTP stands for ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Monopolies and Restrictive Trade Practices.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **MRTP stands for Monopolistic and Restrictive Trade Practices.**
 
• **It was established in 1969.**
 
• This law was designed to ensure that the economic system’s operation does not result in the concentration of economic power in the hands of a few. 
 
• It extends to the whole of India except the State of Jammu and Kashmir.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Monopolistic and Restrictive Trade Practices

 
• The MRTP act was the first substantial legislation with the goal of regulating free and unfettered trade.
 
• This act was geared toward ensuring distinction between restrictive and monopolistic trade practices. 
 
• The initial objectives of the MRTP Act are mentioned below:
 
 
• The law made sure that the economic power does not get concentrated in the hands of a few companies.
 
• To provide for monopolies control.
 
• Regulation of monopolistic and restrictive trade practices.
 
 
 
• The objectives of the MRTP act stood as described below:
 
 
• **MTP - Prohibition of Monopolistic Trade Practices**
 
• **RTP - Prohibition of Restrictive trade practices**
 
• **UTP - Prohibition of Unfair Trade Practices**
